items.title: Wellman Braud Interview, 1958-03-31
items.q: Fellas like Buddy Christian, he was a great district man.

ctx.x: I mean, was the bass on one end or in the back?

The bass is on the rhythm sections always together. The drums and the piano are always together. You know, if it was possible. Sometimes it wasn't possible. But wherever it was possible, it was just the same, because we could feel each other. They used much piano then? Well, we were using piano the whole time I played. I never played as much with guitar the song around here. Yeah, well, I mean down here... We used to use guitar instead of piano around here, you know what I mean? Because you had more of one night…
Was he still in the New Orleans band?
